messages:
sam: quick check on the compact models gallery keyboard behaviour. we added a "compact" density option and Tab now "snaps" to the closest column. SR feedback in usability test: lots of repeated messages and a jittery focus halo when the grid reflows. anyone have quick wins? :mag: rita: saw the recording. focus halo flicker is the big UX gripe. looks like we animate translate/scale on focus which moves the element out of flow. that triggers UA focus rect jumps. noah: recommend two parts: 1) keyboard model: use a single Tab stop for the gallery container, and implement Arrow key 2D nav (roving tabindex). 2) visual: avoid translate/scale on focus; use an outline or box-shadow token like --focus-strong that doesn't change layout. sam: for screen readers, participants asked for concise announcements. current live region says: "Selected model GPT-10, id 93, created at 2026-01-16 14:02" which is too verbose. rita: yeah. change aria-live to polite + debounce 300ms and announce: "Model GPT-10, item 4 of 18, healthy". prefer aria-posinset & aria-setsize on each gridcell so AT can auto-announce position where supported. also add aria-label on the status dot ("status: healthy/unstable"). noah: small accessibility improvement: when the gallery receives focus, set aria-describedby to an offscreen element that explains controls: "Use arrow keys to navigate, Enter to open, Escape to close focus". Keep that live description separate from the live announcements. sam: about aria roles : should we use role=grid / gridcell or keep buttons in a list? rita: both workable. grid semantics are fine for true 2D nav but require implementing Home/End/PageUp/PageDown behaviors. If we keep a simple list, we lose natural 2D movement. I vote grid + implement the extra keys. noah: code sketch: ```
Use arrow keys to move between models. Enter opens details. Escape returns focus to the page. // JS: roving tabindex + Arrow/Home/End/Page handlers, debounce live region updates (300ms) ``` rita: contrast note: the new --focus-strong token on dark theme is currently 3.2:1 against bg. we need 4.5:1 for interactive focus. raise the token contrast or add a thicker outline. created issue A11Y-621. a11y-bot: automated scan: "compact-gallery-focus.png" failed contrast 3.2:1. Issue A11Y-621 created. sam: nice. UX copy nit: for aria-live keep wording minimal and avoid punctuation-heavy announcements. also avoid repeating the gallery title on every announcement. noah: one more idea: allow a preference toggle "announce on focus / announce on open" so power SR users can opt out of focus announcements and only hear when they open a card. could be a later enhancement. rita: agreed. for now let's implement grid + roving tabindex + debounced aria-live + improved focus token. i'll add details to the PR checklist and include keyboard acceptance tests. sam: perfect. ping this thread with the demo link when ready. thanks! :thumbsup:
